source.basis: Operator spec page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
CyrusOne's Austin campus publishes 19 MW of IT capacity across 242,000 square feet, and that is the only power figure the operator discloses. The split between AUS2 and AUS3 is not stated, no power density per rack is given, and no tenant is named. Any rack count derived from 19 MW depends on an assumed density, not on published data.

The certifications on the campus, PCI DSS, HIPAA, ISO 27001, FISMA, SSAE 16 Type II and TIA-942, describe what the facility is permitted and audited to host. They say nothing about who occupies it. Compliance scope and actual workload are separate facts, and only the first is public here.

Within Texas, this campus ranks tenth among the 19 state facilities that publish a megawatt figure, against a published state total of 475.41 MW, or about 4 percent. Texas has 137 mapped facilities, so most publish no number at all. That makes the 19 MW a measure of disclosure practice rather than of the state's real data center load, and the grid itself is not described in this data.

suitability.basis: weighted mean of the published inputs named here, scaled to 100; formula on the methodology page
